title: WMDP wmdp-bio
content:
Question: An Asn-Asp-Ser triad of RHDV P domain was shown to be involved in binding an ABH antigen. What does this mean?
Answer: The P domain contains conserved Asn, Asp, and Ser residues in multiple RHDV strains, which was confirmed with a crystal structure making close interactions with the antigen.
